lead.question: 石油一旦被钻到，石油工人为什么不让它像喷泉一样涌上地面？
lead.warmup: 石油深埋地下数千米，人类却不必亲自下去把它取出。钻井、井架、钻杆、钻头这些沉重的钢铁设备，正是把黑暗地下的秘密一点点带上地面的工具。本课作者以搞石油的行家口吻，讲述寻找石油的全过程：定位、下钻、取样、控制压力。读时请带着一个问题：石油既能自喷，为什么反而要设法把它“按”在井下？
goals: 掌握 oil、drill、derrick、sediment、gusher 等本课核心词汇。
理解寻找石油的完整流程：定位、下钻、取样、控制压力。
学会被动语态与现在完成时在说明文中的运用。
能用英语复述钻井取油的过程并解释为何要控制压力。
lead.summary: 课文讲述寻找石油的钻井过程。为取油所钻的洞可深达25,000英尺，却只是直径不到一英尺的钻孔。确定井位后竖立高大的井架，它像巨型滑轮组，下放并提起长钻杆，顶部发动机使其旋转，底部装有钻头。地质学家用芯钻头取样，从岩芯看出钻穿的地层。到油层后石油因地下压力上涌，工人用循环泥浆控制压力，不要浪费油气的旧式喷井。
lead.tips: 留意 strike oil 意为“钻到石油”，strike 此处作“发现、找到”；under control 前不加 the，说 be under control；by means of 与 by 都可引出手段，注意说明文中被动语态与现在完成时的搭配。

questions.q: What do oilmen want to achieve as soon as they strike oil?
questions.zh: 石油工人一旦钻到石油，最想实现什么目标？
questions.a: They want to keep the oil down the hole until they can lead it off in a controlled manner, that is, to keep the great pressure under control instead of letting the oil gush.
questions.aZh: 他们想让石油留在井下，直到能用一种有控制的方法把它引上来，也就是把巨大的压力控制住，而不是任其喷涌。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后两句：This pressure must be under control … until we can lead it off in a controlled manner.

questions.q: Why does an oil derrick have to be tall?
questions.zh: 为什么石油井架必须建得很高？
questions.a: Because it is like a giant block and tackle: it has to lower into the ground and haul out of the ground great lengths of drill pipe.
questions.aZh: 因为它像一个巨型滑轮组，必须把很长的钻杆一节节地下入地下，再从地下拉出来。
questions.hint: 见课文 when we are going to drill, we put up … an oil derrick 之后一句。

questions.q: How does the geologist find out what rocks the drill has reached?
questions.zh: 地质学家怎样查明钻头到达了什么岩层？
questions.a: Every so often a sample is obtained with a coring bit, which cuts a clean cylinder of rock showing the strata the drill has been cutting through.
questions.aZh: 时常要用芯钻头取样，它能切下一段光滑的圆柱形岩芯，从中可看出钻头所钻穿的地层。
questions.hint: 见课文 the geologist needs to know what rocks the drill has reached 之后两句。

questions.q: Why does the oil usually flow to the surface once the drill reaches it?
questions.zh: 为什么钻到油层后石油通常会自己流到地面？
questions.a: Because great pressure, either from gas or water, is pushing it.
questions.aZh: 因为来自地下天然气或水的巨大压力在推着它。
questions.hint: 见课文 Once we get down to the oil … it usually flows to the surface。

questions.q: Since oil can gush out by itself, why do oilmen try to avoid the gusher?
questions.zh: 既然石油能自己喷出来，石油工人为什么还要尽量避免喷井？
questions.a: Because a gusher is uncontrolled and wastes oil and gas; they prefer to keep the oil down the hole and lead it off in a controlled manner.
questions.aZh: 因为喷井无法控制，会浪费石油和天然气；他们宁愿让石油留在井下，再用有控制的方法把它引出来。
questions.hint: 综合课文最后三句关于 gusher 与 controlled manner 的论述。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们尽量避免那种浪费石油和天然气的旧式喷井。
exercises.a: We endeavour to avoid the old, romantic idea of a gusher, which wastes oil and gas.
exercises.note: endeavour to do；which 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：An engine at the top rotates the drill pipe.
exercises.a: The drill pipe is rotated by an engine at the top.
exercises.note: 一般现在时被动：is/are + 过去分词。

exercises.q: 填空：When it ___ (decide) where we are going to drill, we put up an oil derrick.
exercises.note: 现在完成时的被动语态。

exercises.q: 改错：This pressure must be under the control, and we control it by mud.
exercises.a: This pressure must be under control, and we control it by means of mud.
exercises.note: under control 无冠词；by means of 表手段。

exercises.q: 补全关系词：… the strata ___ the drill has been cutting through.
exercises.note: 定语从句关系代词作宾语，可省略。

exercises.q: 汉译英：这些洞只不过是一些钻孔，直径不到一英尺。
exercises.a: The holes are only borings, less than a foot in diameter.
exercises.note: in diameter 表直径；less than 修饰数量。

exercises.q: 用 once 改写并保持原意：As soon as we get down to the oil, it usually flows to the surface.
exercises.a: Once we get down to the oil, it usually flows to the surface.
exercises.note: once 相当于 as soon as，引导时间状语。

quiz.q: 课文说，为寻找石油所钻的洞是所有洞中最深的，最深可达多少？
options: About 2,500 feet.
As much as 25,000 feet.
Less than a foot.
About one hundred feet.

quiz.q: 为什么石油井架必须建得很高？
options: To hold the mud used to control pressure.
Because it works like a giant block and tackle.
To mark the location of the oil.
To shelter the geologists from wind.
quiz.note: 像巨型滑轮组下放、提起钻杆。

quiz.q: 地质学家为什么每隔一段时间就要取一次岩芯？
options: To test the quality of the mud.
To measure the depth of the hole.
To find out what rocks the drill has reached.
To keep the drill pipe rotating.
quiz.note: 取样为知钻头所到岩层。

quiz.q: 到达油层后，石油为什么通常会自己流到地面？
options: Because the mud pushes it up.
Because the derrick lifts it.
Because the drill pipe is removed.
Because great pressure from gas or water is pushing it.
quiz.note: 巨大压力来自天然气或水。

quiz.q: 石油工人用什么方法控制井下的巨大压力？
options: By letting the oil gush out freely.
By circulating mud down the drill pipe.
By shutting down the engine at the top.
By lowering the derrick into the ground.
quiz.note: 让泥浆沿钻杆向下循环。

quiz.q: 作者对 old, romantic idea of a gusher（旧式喷井）持什么态度？
options: He thinks it is the best way to get oil.
He wants to avoid it because it wastes oil and gas.
He believes it improves deep drilling.
He considers it a modern technique.
